categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent execution of unintended spends and broadcasts when option keys are misspelled in sendall. As noted in the PR description, a typo like 'input' instead of 'inputs' causes the wallet to spend all available UTXOs rather than the intended selection, while misspelling 'add_to_wallet' or 'psbt' can cause unexpected transaction broadcast.
